problem: Optional companion Artifact failures were silently dropped after Promise.allSettled, making a partial scientific result appear complete.
change: Track rejected companion loads, normalize parse failures to ARTIFACT_CONTENT_INVALID, and render a bounded partial-availability status with per-Artifact labels/codes and retry.

verification.failure_behavior: partial availability is explicit and retryable

result: Viewer no longer hides partial companion failures or raw parser errors while preserving read-only scientific authority.
